story.title: Our story
paras: Niel Supply Chain LLC was built to do one thing well: move freight without excuses. As part of Niel Group — One Group. One Global Trade Solution — we combine asset-backed trucking with modern supply chain management and AI-powered operations.

Our roots go back to 2008, when Joma Logistics Inc put its first trucks on the road. Nearly two decades of port drayage, heavy-weight containers, and 24/7 dispatch taught us what shippers actually need: capacity you can count on, and people who answer the phone.

Today, Niel Supply Chain carries that operating DNA forward — with warehouses on both coasts and in the Midwest, a growing fulfillment practice, and every shipment running on NIEL COS, our AI global trade operating system.
